en: parents left me a little money and this house,
you see...
But now even that money is running out.
Be happy for me!
Now, to start planning my next work...
Is your next work ready yet, sir?
Just you watch. My next one will be an epic too.
Oh, it's you...
Isn't your new book finished yet?
I'm so looking forward to it...
What is it,
at this hour...?
So you're staying up late tonight
too, sir...
Yes...
I can't sleep for thinking about my work.
I thought it was just a passing slump, but
I'm washed up...
A writer who starts making excuses is done.
Once that happens, he might as well not be
writing anything at all!
Sir, how about a night stroll right now?
It might be a nice change of pace...
Aaaaaagh...!
A night stroll... I'm sure it will make a
nice change of pace...
Come to London to see the sights,
have you, sir?
Only, you look at everything like it's new.
You can just sort of tell these things,
Come again, won't you.
If you're going sightseeing,
somewhere like Westminster
might be nice.
See the abbey and feel all pious, then
get worldly again with a pint at a pub.
That's the stylish way to do it.
So, has my tour guiding been
any use to you?
If you haven't been yet,
the fancy shops in Piccadilly are
great for a spot of shopping.
Hey, you're staying in London a good while,
it seems.
note: Shared with Norman msg 226762: M2#5511 must end with a comma so 'it seems.' follows, e.g. 'Lately you've been seen all over the place,'.

en: Planning to buy a mansion in Piccadilly?
Honestly, I envy you rich folk.
Say, have you been to any of the pubs
in Westminster?
Apparently there's a secret gambling den
in one of 'em.
Just a rumor, mind you.
Sorry, we're closed for today.
We're closed for today.
Come back tomorrow.
Sorry, I've already shut the shop for today.
Hey, chatting with you has become
a daily habit of mine.
Keep giving me your custom, eh?
I hear there's a secret gambling den
What is it, at this hour?
Sorry, but I'd like you to show me
around the town tonight.
At this hour?
I'm counting on you
You'll keep me company on a night walk for a while.
Ugh
My whole body hurts somehow
Gimme your orders
Lately I just can't get properly drunk
Seems I pass out come nightfall,
and I don't remember a thing.
Pardon me, this is the liquor shop, is it not?
Yeah, that's right. Not open now, though.
Mind you, my belly's still
full of booze.
If it's the liquor shop you want,
come by when it's open.
Shop's not open yet.
